title: The Final Demise of Light Yagami Part 5

series.summary: Critically wounded and pursued by the Task Force, Light flees into the sunset and encounters the phantom of his innocent past self before collapsing in an abandoned warehouse. Perched high above, Ryuk fulfills their original pact by writing Light's name in the Death Note, and as his forty seconds expire, Light suffers a fatal heart attack beneath the silent gaze of L's apparition.

cuts.voiceover_text: Every bleeding bullet wound confirms that Kira's divine empire is officially dead. Light Yagami staggers into the blinding sunset, clutching his mangled abdomen in raw terror. He is completely shattered. All his arrogant delusions of godhood have collapsed into a desperate scramble for survival. Behind him, heavy metal doors swing open. The Task Force bursts into the fading daylight, scanning the shipping yard to finish the hunt. Light drags his heavy boots across the dusty pavement, gasping through clenched teeth. Blood pools through his trembling fingers with every step. There is no glorious escape waiting at the docks. His pride is gone. Only animal instinct keeps his broken body stumbling forward.

Further down the industrial road, Light's failing strength evaporates. He stumbles past a solitary figure walking in a high school uniform. It is his younger self. The innocent boy carries his book bag toward an uncorrupted future. The contrast is devastating. Light stares in disbelief, crushed by what he traded away. He turns and stumbles onward.

High above the harbor on a steel tower, Ryuk watches his fallen partner crawl into hiding. The Shinigami is not here to save him. Instead, Ryuk coldly invokes the forgotten pact they made on the day they first met. He explains that watching Light rot inside a prison cell would be agonizingly boring. Their twisted partnership is finished, and he refuses to wait around. Ryuk pulls out his black Death Note and uncaps his pen. With a chilling grin, the death god etches Light Yagami's name into the paper. The sentence is signed. Exactly forty seconds remain until the verdict is carried out. There is no escape from this execution.

Inside the gloomy stairwell of an abandoned warehouse, Light lies collapsed across the concrete steps. His breathing slows as the silence thickens. Then, the forty seconds expire. A violent spasm tears through his chest. The fatal heart attack strikes with merciless force, wrenching a choked gasp from his throat. Light claws desperately at his chest, writhing in pure agony across the stairs. Through the blur of his fading sight, a familiar shadow appears at the landing above. L stands motionless in the doorway, staring down at him in solemn judgment. Light's wide eyes lock onto his eternal nemesis. The panic drains from his face, replaced by total resignation. His trembling hand drops to the floor. His eyes drift shut. The self-proclaimed God of the New World dies entirely alone.
